| UM-T34 | 2026-10-20 | fix | closed | A kicked or replaced client can lose the reason it was given: NetSession.Kick and the stale-connection takeover call NGO DisconnectClient(reason), which sends the reason as a reliable message and closes the transport connection at once, so if that message is dropped (or, under UM-T14's simulator stage, still delayed) the client only sees ClosedByRemote and reports ServerShutdown instead of Kicked with the message. Deliver the reason first (e.g. own reliable message, client leaves on receipt, server force-closes after a grace) and assert the reason in LossyNetworkTests.KilledClient_ReconnectingOverTheLossyLink_TakesItsSeatBack. | LossyNetworkTests.KilledClient_ReconnectingOverTheLossyLink_TakesItsSeatBack @ 00048ca |
